description: Who lists the paperwork each US rule for a product asks for. Checks every exhibitor selling the product (counts per rule), plus up to 10 named exhibitors and the others that list the most, in detail: which list a matching certificate, which only claim it in a product listing, which have only a foreign mark or a lab name; and which rules are the importer's own job. Spends one search.

refs.description: Exhibitor refs (E1234) from search_listings to check in detail. Leave out to check the ones that list the most.
